Subject: Helios vendor onboarding — initial checklist & banking options

Hi Samantha,

Thanks for confirming Helios as a preferred vendor for the integration work. To get you into our AP system and ensure timely payments, can you please provide the following items so procurement can create the vendor record?

- Completed vendor onboarding form (attached PDF or DocuSign)
- W-9 (or local tax form)
- Bank details: account name, account number, routing number (for ACH) and SWIFT/BIC + IBAN if you prefer wires
- Preferred remittance email for invoice confirmations (who we should CC when payments are issued)
- Invoice submission method: AP portal vs email (if email, please confirm the exact address to send to)
- Any payment terms deviations (we default to Net 30 from invoice date)

Important notes:
- We prefer ACH for domestic US vendors (lower fees) but will do wires for one-off international transfers; let us know which you prefer.
- Redwood requires a PO to match invoices for services above $5,000. If your invoices exceed that, please include PO number on the invoice.

If you can get back to me with the completed form and W-9 today or tomorrow, procurement can usually finish setup within 3 business days. I copied Laura from Procurement and Mina on AP so they have visibility.

Thanks — next steps after we receive the docs: vendor record created, vendor ID provided, and we confirm payment terms and remittance address.

Best,
Marcus Lin

Hi Samantha —

Thanks for the quick turnaround and for attaching the forms. A couple quick clarifications from procurement before we create the vendor record:

1) ACH vs Wire: since you indicated ACH preference for USD, we'll set ACH as the primary payment method in our system. For cross-border invoices we'll keep wire as an alternate option — procurement will only trigger a wire if you invoice in non-USD or if a customer-requested expedited payment is needed.

2) Remittance email: we will use billing@helios-systems.com as the remittance address and will CC ap@helios-systems.com when payments process. Please confirm you are OK with payment advices being sent from payments@redwoodinference.com.

3) PO requirements: Redwood requires a PO number on invoices for any invoice >= $5,000. For smaller invoices we can process without a PO but we ask that invoices include a clear description and dates of service.

4) Invoice format: PDF invoices attached to email are fine, but if you will be using our AP portal please request access via this vendor portal link (I'll assign an account once the vendor record is created): https://redwoodinference.app/vendor-portal/helios-123

If everything above is OK, we'll proceed to create the vendor record and provide a vendor ID. Payment terms will be Net 30 unless you have a signed SOW that specifies different terms.

Laura Bennett
Procurement Manager | Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com

Hi Samantha —

Welcome — I'm on Redwood's Accounts Payable team. A few operational items so invoicing and payments are smooth: 

- Invoice submission: ap@redwoodinference.com is monitored; please either email invoices as a single PDF per invoice to that address OR upload via the vendor portal link Laura provided.
- Remittance: We'll send remittance advices to billing@helios-systems.com and CC ap@helios-systems.com when payments are issued. Payment emails will come from payments@redwoodinference.com.
- PO matching: Please include PO number (if provided) on the invoice header and also within the line items. Missing PO numbers for invoices >= $5,000 will delay payment until procurement provides the PO (typical turnaround 2 business days).
- Payment schedule: Net 30 from invoice date. If you need accelerated payment for a one-time expedited wire, include a request to payments@redwoodinference.com with reason and we'll route for approval (fees may apply).

If you want, I can create a test invoice entry to confirm the portal/email route before sending a live invoice.

Thanks,
Mina Haddad
